name: Apron climbers' lot on Highway 99 at the Mamquam forest road
basis: Mountain Project Apron page Getting There: 'Start at a parking lot at the intersection of Highway 99 and a Mamquam Forest Service Road'; a guide places the Apron car park at the Mamquam FSR turn directly below the climbing, ~500 m north of the Chief campsite, separate from the main Chief lot. Brief lot is the one named Climbers Parking Lot, at the Apron's own coordinate (49.6863,-123.1474). Matched by position/name.

name: Stawamus Chief day-use lot by the campground
basis: Boulder guide: 'Park in the campground lot or in the main Chief pullout lot'; Sendage campground boulders page: exit Hwy 99 to the Chief park, turn right at roundabout and park as close to the campground as possible; BC Parks: trails start from the day-use parking area near the campground. Brief lot named Day-use Parking Lot sits at the campground.

name: Stawamus Chief day-use lot by the campground
basis: Boulder guide for the Titanic/Viper Grand Wall boulders: park in the campground lot or the main Chief pullout lot; listing says Grand Wall boulders are ~5 min walk from the campground. Campground-side day-use lot chosen by position.
